title: Khazana
overview: Garage Mechanic Rajkumar lives a middle-classed lifestyle in Bombay along with widower father, Shantidas. One day he is informed that his father has been arrested for robbing a jeweler. He goes to visit his father and finds that he has been hospitalized in Nanavati Hospital. The doctor informs him that chances of recovery are good.

songs.title: Khazane Ki Chabi Mere Paas Hai
Hum Bhi Musafir Tum Bhi Musafir
Diwana Sayano Ko Diwana Bana Gaya
songs.singers: Mohammed Rafi, Asha Bhosle, Usha Mangeshkar
